entities.name: Germ Theory of Disease
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The theory that many diseases are caused by microorganisms invading the body. Established by Pasteur, Koch, and Lister in the 1860s–1880s, germ theory revolutionized medicine, surgery, and public health, leading to vaccines, antibiotics, and sanitation practices that have saved hundreds of millions of lives.
